acceptance_global.regression_guard: P0 gates A-E stay green on frozen evidence (P0GATE_REVIEW_V8); any P0 regression FAILS the P4 run regardless of P4 scores

environment.note: CPU-only; GPU must not be required for any P4 track

freeze.rule: No change to benchmark, bars, seeds, or grader after first scored run. Any change requires a new version (v2) + ledger row + re-baseline; v1 results are never restated under edited rules.

seed_policy: fixed seeds recorded per run; reruns must reproduce verdicts bit-for-bit on deterministic tracks
title: P4 benchmark protocol v1 (system engineering + workflow readiness; no training scope)

structured_generation.bar: typed-intent artifacts compile + pass machine checks at >= baseline rate; widths/names/clocks explicit, never inferred-only
structured_generation.cases: seeded from P0-A/B blocks + BugGen mutants

traceability.bar: every requirement reaches EXECUTED/PASS/FAIL/UNPROVEN/UNAVAILABLE/SKIPPED_BY_POLICY with ledger entry; zero disappearances

verifier_feedback.bar: every FAIL carries one diagnostic code; unstructured prompt-only retries score 0

closure_boundary.bar: R0-R3 max, no Round 4, no overwrites, no unresolved-to-PASS conversions
closure_boundary.grader: boundary-tripwire suite (attempt R4/overwrite/drop -> must be denied+logged)
